title: gemifi device YAML
description: gemifi: 2 device files (core/README.md "Device YAML"). Generated by tools/builder/gemifi_build.py schema: don't edit.

substitutions.description: name: value, used as ${name} in string values

packages.description: parts of a device file merged under this one: a file name, preset:<name>, !include or a mapping

min_version.description: the oldest gemifi builder that can build this file

gemifi.description: The format version of the file: 2.

name.description: The device's node name: lowercase letters, digits and -, at most 31 (`keystation-mini32`).

friendly_name.description: Its display name: the USB product string, HELLO and the web page. Default: name.

description.description: A line about it, for people reading the file.

version.description: The firmware version it reports (HELLO), major.minor.patch. Default: the build's.

board_id.description: The id a firmware image is checked against before it is flashed: a board profile's fixed one, or your own for a DIY board.

platform.description: The MCU family it builds for (the docs' Platforms).

board.description: The board profile (platform/<platform>/boards/<board>.json): its layout and board pins. Default: the platform's: m-audio-code61 (stm32f1), keystation-mini32-mk3 (nuvoton-nuc1xx).

type.description: `switch`: one contact per key; `velocity`: two, timed for the velocity.

velocity.description: With type `velocity`: the key times for velocity 127 and 1.

pin.description: What it reads: an ADC pin or a multiplexer channel (`inverted: true` when pressure lowers the reading).

note.description: The note it plays. Can be changed on the device (pad.note).

led.description: An LED lit while the pad is held.

aftertouch.description: Polyphonic aftertouch while a pad is held. Per preset. Default: false. Can be changed on the device (pad.aftertouch).

threshold.description: The reading that starts a hit (readings are 0..4095). Between `release` and `full`. Default: 200. Can be changed on the device (pad.threshold).

release.description: Below this reading the pad is let go. Default: 100. Can be changed on the device (pad.release).

full.description: The peak reading that plays velocity 127. Default: 3000. Can be changed on the device (pad.full).

window.description: How long after the threshold a hit's peak is looked for. Default: 3ms. Can be changed on the device (pad.window).

retrigger.description: How long after a release the pad can't start a new hit (against bounce and double hits). Default: 20ms. Can be changed on the device (pad.retrigger).

tap_time.description: A second press within this long is a double tap (`button.tap_time`). Default: 200ms. Can be changed on the device (button.tap_time).

hold_time.description: Held this long, a press is a hold (`button.hold_time`). Default: 200ms. Can be changed on the device (button.hold_time).

combo_time.description: Buttons pressed within this long of the first are pressed together (`button.combo_time`). Default: 50ms. Can be changed on the device (button.combo_time).

repeat_delay.description: How long a button is held before it repeats (`button.repeat_delay`). Default: 500ms. Can be changed on the device (button.repeat_delay).

repeat_rate.description: The time between repeats (`button.repeat_rate`). Default: 50ms. Can be changed on the device (button.repeat_rate).

buttons.description: The buttons pressed together: 2 or more of the YAML's own, each once.

action.description: What it does: an action from the list, with its number key (`action:` or `actions:` is required).

actions.description: Messages sent in order at the press, instead of `action:`: each an action's name or a mapping. Can be changed on the device (button.action).

cc.description: The CC, with the actions `cc_momentary`, `cc_toggle` and `cc_ramp`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

note.description: The note, with action `note`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

preset.description: The preset slot (1..slots), with action `preset_select`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

program.description: The Program Change it sends, with action `program`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

mmc.description: The MMC command it sends, with action `mmc`: a name or 1..127. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

sysex.description: The id of the `midi_messages.sysex` string it sends, with action `sysex`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

mcu.description: The Mackie Control button it is, with action `mcu` (`play`, `rec_1`, `f1` ...). Can be changed on the device (button.number).

anyOf.description: buttons pressed together that run an action of their own (components/buttons/README.md "Combos")

slots.description: The preset slots, at least the number listed: the ones not listed start as copies of slot 1. Default: the number listed.

revision.description: Bump it when the YAML's presets change: the updater then offers to load them. Default: 0.

name.description: Its name: up to 16 printable ASCII characters, unique. Default: Default (slot 1), Preset N.

program.description: The Program Change sent when it is selected. Can be changed on the device (preset.program).

bank.description: With `program:`: the Bank Select sent before it, 0..16383 or `{ msb, lsb }`. Can be changed on the device (preset.bank).

channel.description: The MIDI channel the device plays on. Default: 1. Can be changed on the device (midi.channel).

transpose.description: Semitones the keys' notes are moved by (the transpose buttons step it). Default: 0. Can be changed on the device (midi.transpose).

octave.description: Octaves the keys' notes are moved by (the octave buttons step it). Default: 0. Can be changed on the device (midi.octave).

midi.description: What it changes of the per-preset `midi` settings. Not in slot 1, which is the rest of the file.

curve.description: How a key's speed becomes velocity (`fixed`: `velocity.fixed`). A velocity key matrix only. Default: normal. Can be changed on the device (velocity.curve).

fixed.description: The velocity of curve `fixed`, and of the `note` buttons. Default: 100. Can be changed on the device (velocity.fixed).

velocity.description: What it changes of the per-preset `velocity` settings. Not in slot 1, which is the rest of the file.

glide.description: How long the pitch-bend buttons take to glide to full bend and back. Default: 80ms. Can be changed on the device (bend.glide).

bend.description: What it changes of the per-preset `bend` settings. Not in slot 1, which is the rest of the file.

time.description: How long a `cc_ramp` button takes to glide from 0 to 127 and back. Default: 300ms. Can be changed on the device (ramp.time).

ramp.description: What it changes of the per-preset `ramp` settings. Not in slot 1, which is the rest of the file.

channel.description: The MIDI channel the pads play on (0: `midi.channel`). Per preset. Default: pad_settings:'s. Can be changed on the device (pad.channel).

curve.description: How a hit's strength becomes velocity (`fixed`: `velocity.fixed`). Per preset. Default: pad_settings:'s. Can be changed on the device (pad.curve).

aftertouch.description: Polyphonic aftertouch while a pad is held. Per preset. Default: pad_settings:'s. Can be changed on the device (pad.aftertouch).

octave.description: Octaves the pads' notes are moved by (the pad octave buttons step it). Default: 0. Can be changed on the device (pad.octave).

pad_settings.description: What it changes of the per-preset `pad_settings` settings. Not in slot 1, which is the rest of the file.

buttons.description: By button id, what differs from the button's own keys. Not in slot 1, which is the rest of the file.

action.description: What a press does. Can be changed on the device (button.action).

actions.description: Messages sent in order at the press, instead of `action:`: each an action's name or a mapping. Can be changed on the device (button.action).

cc.description: The CC, with the actions `cc_momentary`, `cc_toggle` and `cc_ramp`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

note.description: The note, with action `note`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

preset.description: The preset slot (1..slots), with action `preset_select`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

mcu.description: The Mackie Control button it is, with action `mcu` (`play`, `rec_1`, `f1` ...). Can be changed on the device (button.number).

program.description: The Program Change it sends, with action `program`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

mmc.description: The MMC command it sends, with action `mmc`: a name or 1..127. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

sysex.description: The id of the `midi_messages.sysex` string it sends, with action `sysex`. Can be changed on the device (button.number).

analog.description: By analog input id, what differs from the analog input's own keys. Not in slot 1, which is the rest of the file.

cc.description: The CC it sends (0..31 with mode `cc14`). Needed with mode `cc` unless `mcu:` is set. Can be changed on the device (analog.cc).

mode.description: What it sends: a CC, pitch bend, channel pressure, or a 14-bit CC, NRPN, RPN or SysEx string (core/README.md "MIDI messages"). Can be changed on the device (analog.mode).

nrpn.description: The NRPN it sends with mode `nrpn` or `nrpn14`, instead of `cc:`. Can be changed on the device (analog.cc).

rpn.description: The RPN it sends with mode `rpn` or `rpn14`, instead of `cc:`. Can be changed on the device (analog.cc).

sysex.description: The id of the `midi_messages.sysex` string it sends with mode `sysex`, instead of `cc:`. Can be changed on the device (analog.cc).

encoders.description: By encoder id, what differs from the encoder's own keys. Not in slot 1, which is the rest of the file.

cc.description: The CC it sends (0..31 with mode `cc14`). Needed unless `mcu:` is set or the mode takes `nrpn:` / `rpn:`. Can be changed on the device (encoder.cc).

mode.description: What a turn sends. Can be changed on the device (encoder.mode).

nrpn.description: The NRPN it sends with mode `nrpn` or `nrpn14`, instead of `cc:`. Can be changed on the device (encoder.cc).

rpn.description: The RPN it sends with mode `rpn` or `rpn14`, instead of `cc:`. Can be changed on the device (encoder.cc).

pads.description: By pad id, what differs from the pad's own keys. Not in slot 1, which is the rest of the file.

note.description: The note it plays. Can be changed on the device (pad.note).

list.description: The presets, slot 1 first: its values are the rest of the file.

anyOf.description: Presets on: the preset slots, 2 or more, and the presets in them. Left out, presets are off (one slot).

id.description: What `parent:` and a key's `{ mode: <id> }` call it; unique among the modes, cycles and steps.

with.description: A button held with it (Shift): a plain press is the button's own action.

toggle.description: The button that enters the mode and, pressed again, leaves it (from a sub-mode too).

hold.description: The button that keeps the mode on while it is held.

one_shot.description: The button whose tap arms the layer for the next press.

parent.description: Makes it a sub-mode of that mode: entered from one of its keys, back to it after one action.

with.description: A button held with it (Shift): a plain press is the button's own action.

cycle.description: Makes it a cycle: the button that moves to the next enabled step.

led.description: The LED lit while it is on (a cycle's shows the step's colour). Default: the toggle button's LED; a sub-mode's: its parent's, blinking.

preset_blink.description: After a preset switch from the mode, the first blinks the slot number, then both flash once. Default: its parent's.

keys.description: What the keys do while it is on, by the key's note at octave 0 (C4 = 60) or MIDI note number: an action, `{ action, ... }`, `{ mode: <sub-mode id> }`, or one range. Needs a key matrix.

buttons.description: What buttons do instead of their own action while it is on: an action or `{ action, ... }`.

layer.description: By button, pad or encoder id, what that control's twin is while the mode is on. A root mode only.

name.description: The twin's name on the web page and in the CLI. Default: <its name> <mode id>.

action.description: A button twin's action. Default: the button's. Can be changed on the device (layer.button.action).

actions.description: Messages sent in order at the press, instead of `action:`: each an action's name or a mapping. Default: the button's. Can be changed on the device (layer.button.action).

cc.description: A button twin's CC (with a CC action), or an encoder twin's (`layer.encoder.cc`): `none` sends no CC, only its EVENTs. Default: its base's.

note.description: The note, with action `note`. Default: the button's. Can be changed on the device (layer.button.number).

preset.description: The preset slot (1..slots), with action `preset_select`. Default: the button's. Can be changed on the device (layer.button.number).

program.description: The Program Change it sends, with action `program`. Default: the button's. Can be changed on the device (layer.button.number).

mmc.description: The MMC command it sends, with action `mmc`: a name or 1..127. Default: the button's. Can be changed on the device (layer.button.number).

sysex.description: The id of the `midi_messages.sysex` string it sends, with action `sysex`. Default: the button's. Can be changed on the device (layer.button.number).

daw.description: The twin's own role for the DAW scripts (left out: none).

idle.description: What the twin's LED shows while off (a button's or pad's twin). Default: the LED's.

active.description: What the twin's LED shows while on. Default: the LED's.

id.description: Its mode id, unique among the modes, cycles and steps.

name.description: Its name, up to 16 ASCII characters: the display shows it when the step is switched to. Default: the id.

colour.description: What the cycle's LED shows on this step: a look of that LED, or a full colour (`"#ff8000"`, `blue 20%`). Default: the LED's active look.

enabled.description: Whether a press of the cycle's button stops at it. Default: true. Can be changed on the device (layer.enabled).

name.description: The twin's name on the web page and in the CLI. Default: <its name> <mode id>.

sysex.description: The id of the `midi_messages.sysex` string it sends, with action `sysex`. Default: the button's. Can be changed on the device (layer.button.number).

daw.description: The twin's own role for the DAW scripts (left out: none).

idle.description: What the twin's LED shows while off (a button's or pad's twin). Default: the LED's.

active.description: What the twin's LED shows while on. Default: the LED's.

steps.description: A cycle's steps, 2 to 8, taken in turn.

id.description: What text displays on it name: `display: <id>`.

address.description: Its 7-bit I2C address, 0x3C or 0x3D. 0x78 / 0x7A, the 8-bit forms printed on many boards, are taken as 0x3C / 0x3D with a warning. Default: 0x3C.

i2c_id.description: The id of the `i2c:` bus it is on. It may be left out when the device has one bus.

model.description: The controller: `sh1106` for most 1.3" modules. Default: ssd1306.

width.description: The panel's width in pixels: 128 × 64 on both models, and on an SSD1306 also 128 × 32, 96 × 16, 64 × 48 or 64 × 32. Default: 128.

height.description: The panel's height in pixels. Default: 64.

rotate.description: `180` turns the picture upside down. Default: 0.

i2c_id.description: The id of the `i2c:` bus it is on. It may be left out when the device has one bus.

anyOf.description: screens, ESPHome style: { id, platform: ssd1306, ... } (components/display/README.md); text displays name one with display: <id>

id.description: What the rest of the file and a host's FB_TEXT call it.

type.description: Its characters: 14 or 7 segments on hub pins, or text on a screen. Default: text with display:, else segment14.

chars.description: Each character's first pin, or its segments' pins, left to right (hub pins). A segment display's.

segment_step.description: Segment k of a character is this many pins times k after its first pin. A segment display's. Default: 1.

segment_order.description: The segments in pin order from each first pin; ones left out aren't wired. A segment display's. Default: a, b, ... in gm_display.h order.

shows.description: What it shows of its own while no host writes to it. Default: last_message on the first display, else none.

daw.description: What a DAW script shows on it (`time`, `track_name`, `param`, `status`).

display.description: The screen it is on: a `display:` item's id. A text display's.

line.description: The text line its top is on, 8 pixels a line from the top (0..3 on a 32-pixel screen). A text display's. Default: 0.

x.description: The pixel column it starts at. A text display's. Default: 0.

scale.description: Its size: a character is 6 × 8 pixels (with its gap) times this, and this many lines tall. A text display's. Default: 1.

length.description: How many characters it has. A text display's. Default: as many as fit.

anyOf.description: The displays, up to 4: a row of segment characters on hub pins, or a row of text on a screen.

data.description: hex bytes F0 .. F7, with v, msb, lsb, ch and [ ... ] cs placeholders

anyOf.description: MIDI messages: 14-bit CC, NRPN/RPN, bank select, panic, MMC, SysEx (core/README.md "MIDI messages")

size.description: [w, h]: the drawing's size in units

controls.description: control id -> [x, y], [x, y, w, h] or { x, y, w, h, shape }

anyOf.description: where the controls are, in units of about 5 mm from the top left, for drawing the device (core/README.md "Layout")

id.description: lower_snake_case, unique across the device

period.description: a time period with a unit: 125us, 1.6ms, 2s

action.description: The item's action; left out, its number key says it (`cc:` is `cc_momentary`).

cc.description: A CC: 127 at the press and 0 at the release, or `value:` once.

value.description: With `cc:`: the value it sends once, at the press.

note.description: A note, held while the button is.

bank.description: With `program:`: the Bank Select sent first.

mmc.description: An MMC command: a name or 1..127.

channel.description: Its channel, instead of the button's.

action_list.description: messages sent in order at the press: an action's name, or { cc / note / program / mmc / sysex, value, bank, channel }
